source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Five linked details inspected in the cloud browser after the scheduled start. Four normal detail pages and one rendered 404 page. Nonessential cookies rejected. Four current DOM covers downloaded and decoded. No gameplay inputs, voting, authentication, or user computer used.

limitations: Bounded public UI sample, not a complete catalog or independently verified heat score.
The homepage 热门免费游戏 numbered list contains only five games; no unrelated entries added to fill the requested maximum of ten.
Homepage numbered positions and detail popularity ranks are separate displays and may disagree.
Likes/dislikes use rounded source abbreviations. Votes are not plays, unique users or concurrency.
Date labels retain month-level precision; no exact release date invented.
Subway Surfers detail title shows 404未找到结果 and rendered error text says the page does not exist; HTTP response status is not exposed. This is not a permanent delisting claim.
Game frames may auto-load on detail visits; no gameplay inputs, voting, login or hidden APIs used.
Short-interval source changes may reflect hydration, display or cache differences; no growth or popularity velocity inferred.

Four covers were freshly downloaded from rendered detail images. Actual decoded bytes are AVIF at 314 × 314 pixels although URL suffixes are PNG. Hashes, formats and pixels were validated; all four match existing assets.
No numeric online display observed on any inspected detail in this run; all online metric values are null. Prior lower-bound labels were not carried forward.

Both Level Devil reads in this run display 2023年12月. The latest prior snapshot reported 2023年12月 and 2023年11月 within that earlier run; retained only as historical context, not a current conflict or real-world release-date change.
